**Checking the Node.js and NPM Versions**

Alright, the system finally finished upgrading `nodejs` to version `20.20.2`. Time to verify that the update took properly. I'll quickly check the versions of `node` and `npm` using `node -v` and `npm -v` in the terminal. It's a fundamental step; I want to ensure the environment is updated and ready to work with the latest features and potential performance improvements of the new Node version. It's second nature, really; always confirm the environment after a major update to avoid any unexpected issues down the line.
